title: THE RADICALIZATION RISKS OF GPT-3 AND ADVANCED NEURAL LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: The paper found that GPT-3 is highly effective at generating religiously-inflected extremist content, particularly anti-Semitic narratives consistent with neo-Nazi ideology found on forums like Iron March. With minimal few-shot prompting, the model could be biased to produce conspiratorial answers related to anti-Semitic tropes (e.g., about the Rothschilds) and QAnon's quasi-religious beliefs about 'satanic elites'. The model also demonstrated multilingual capabilities by generating coherent, anti-Semitic text in Russian based on English prompts. A predecessor model, GPT-2, was also noted as being capable of producing Islamist manifestos, though it was less flexible than GPT-3.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the model's capacity to generate ideologically consistent extremist content, with a specific focus on its ability to produce anti-Semitic narratives, emulate neo-Nazi forum discussions, and answer questions from a conspiratorial, anti-Semitic viewpoint. It also mentioned testing a prior model (GPT-2) on its ability to produce Islamist extremist texts.
